description: Default consent form templates. Placeholders: {{patient_name}}, {{date}}, {{doctor_name}}, {{clinic_name}}, {{procedure}}. Have the wording reviewed for your own practice before use.

templates.name: General Dental Treatment
templates.body:
I, {{patient_name}}, consent to dental examination and treatment ({{procedure}}) by {{doctor_name}} at {{clinic_name}}.

The nature of the treatment, its expected benefits, the possible risks and the available alternatives (including no treatment) have been explained to me in a language I understand, and my questions have been answered.

I understand that dentistry is not an exact science and that no guarantee of outcome has been given. I have disclosed my complete medical history, current medication and known allergies.

I agree to follow the post-treatment instructions given to me and to pay the fees discussed.

Date: {{date}}

templates.name: Tooth Extraction
templates.body:
I, {{patient_name}}, consent to the extraction of the tooth/teeth described as: {{procedure}}, to be carried out by {{doctor_name}} at {{clinic_name}}.

I have been informed of the alternatives to extraction and of the possible risks, including pain, swelling, bleeding, infection, dry socket, damage to adjacent teeth or fillings, jaw stiffness, temporary or rarely permanent numbness of the lip, chin or tongue, sinus involvement for upper teeth, and the possible need for further treatment.

I consent to the use of local anaesthesia and have disclosed my medical history, medication and allergies.

Date: {{date}}

templates.name: Root Canal Treatment
templates.body:
I, {{patient_name}}, consent to root canal treatment ({{procedure}}) by {{doctor_name}} at {{clinic_name}}.

I understand that the treatment may need more than one visit and that risks include post-operative pain or swelling, instrument separation inside the canal, perforation, missed or blocked canals, failure of the treatment requiring re-treatment, surgery or extraction, and fracture of the tooth. I have been advised that a crown is usually required after root canal treatment and that it is charged separately.

I consent to the use of local anaesthesia and have disclosed my medical history, medication and allergies.

Date: {{date}}
